scientific_conclusion: See measured crossovers; a difference from the precision backbone is a finding, not tuned.

backbone.name: covariance readout
backbone.recovery_rule: w_i = v_max(Cov(Y_0) - Cov(Y_e(i))), Z_i = Y_0 w_i
backbone.null: size-matched; disjoint split when n_e <= n_0/2, else two-resample
backbone.relabel_note: Run first as 'Backbone B'. Relabelled a negative control on 2026-09-26 after the Mac preview showed its recovery rule reaches MCC 0.898 with exact population covariances; the decision was made after that number was seen.

estimator: covariance readout rows for the supplied targets plus the unchanged E2c absolute-eigenvalue spectral completion of the pooled interventional-minus-control covariance in their orthogonal complement.
primary_metric: Hungarian MCC; permutation and sign safe, axis-sensitive.

preregistered_expectation.statement: gate restricts no later than the first m where mean random-subset MCC falls below 0.90

precision_reference.note: precision readout; current code reproduces its decisions exactly (floating-point values agree to about 1e-11 across OS/BLAS versions)

subspace_r2_invariance.explanation: A full-rank 5x5 transform preserves the column span of the 5D projected observations, so full-dimensional linear subspace R2 cannot diagnose axis recovery.
